{"response":{"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","responseId":"YdaKaeisCObYqtsPqJCv8QY","usageMetadata":{"totalTokenCount":19512,"candidatesTokenCount":528,"promptTokenCount":6039,"thoughtsTokenCount":12945,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":6039}]},"candidates":[{"index":0,"content":{"parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  // Stable mode uses reluctant doubling strategy\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Step 1: Retrieve the current short-term and long-term EMA of LBD\n  const double fast_glue = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow_glue = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 2: Calculate the trend ratio R = fast_glue / slow_glue\n  double R = 1.0;\n  if (slow_glue \u003e 0.0)\n    R = fast_glue / slow_glue;\n\n  // Step 3: Define a scaling factor S\n  double S = 1.0;\n  if (R \u003e 1.10)\n    S = 0.75; // Degrading quality, encourage earlier restart\n  else if (R \u003c 0.90)\n    S = 1.35; // Improving quality, delay restart\n\n  // Step 4: Retrieve the current scheduled restart limit\n  const uint64_t limit = solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts;\n\n  // Step 5: Compare the current conflict count to (limit * S)\n  const uint64_t adjusted_limit = (uint64_t)(limit * S);\n\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c adjusted_limit)\n    return false;\n\n  // Survival Check:\n  // If S \u003c 1.0 (aggressive restart mode) but the search is finding high-quality conflicts,\n  // we delay the restart.\n  // The algorithm specifies checking if the \"most recent conflict had an LBD \u003c= 2\".\n  // Since the exact LBD of the last conflict is not directly exposed in the restricted API,\n  // we use the fast EMA of glue as a proxy. If fast_glue is very low (\u003c 2.0),\n  // it implies recent conflicts have been of high quality (glue clauses).\n  if (S \u003c 1.0) {\n    if (fast_glue \u003c 2.0)\n      return false;\n  }\n\n  return true;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP"}]},"key":"req-0001","model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
